thread:
ana: Heads-up — triage request: three docs PRs stuck in review. #4123 migration guide, #4130 SDK snippet, #4134 link fix. Can we assign owners?
kevin: I can take #4130 (SDK snippets). Please add the preview link when ready.
maria: I'll pick up #4123 (migration guide). It's a bigger diff; will need a second reviewer.
sam: I can be the second reviewer for migration guides — ping me when it's ready.
olivia: Small fixes like #4134 I can merge today if CI is green. :+1:
docs-bot: CI alert — PR #4123 preview failed: missing frontmatter in docs/migration/upgrade.md. Logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/4123/console
kevin: CI for #4130 passed. Preview: https://deploy-preview-4130.docs.redwood.ai
maria: I'll push a frontmatter fix to #4123 in a moment. Also proposing a CODEOWNERS entry so migration guides always get two reviewers:
maria: ```
/docs/migration/ @maria @sam
```
tyler: +1 to that CODEOWNERS idea. Also there's a coverage gap for SDK snippets — no one is on rotation right now.
olivia: Suggestion: lightweight docs on-call (1 person/week) to clear the queue. We can put schedule in the docs-review calendar and update README.
kevin: I'll take SDK snippets this week and add a small checklist for PRs (preview link, minimal examples for Python/Node, and API surface note).
maria: Done — pushed frontmatter fix to #4123. @sam can you re-run preview when you have a sec?
sam: Will do in ~30m. If the migration guide adds a changelog snippet it's good to go; otherwise I'll request a small follow-up.
docs-bot: Preview ready for #4123: https://deploy-preview-4123.docs.redwood.ai — build succeeded.
sam: Reviewed #4123, left one nit on wording and asked for a changelog line. @maria if you push that I'll approve and we can merge.
olivia: I merged #4134 (link fix). Preview: https://deploy-preview-4134.docs.redwood.ai :tada: 
tyler: I'll update the docs-review rotation doc and drop a note in #general about who to ping for different doc types (migration, SDK, small fixes).
kevin: FYI I'll add a CODEOWNERS suggestion for SDK snippets under /docs/sdk/ @kevin @olivia so we have some coverage.
maria: Thanks everyone — looks like we're unblocked. Can we treat CODEOWNERS changes as follow-up RFC in the docs repo? If yes I'll open it.
kevin: Yes please—open it and tag me. Happy to help define the rotation.
olivia: Thanks all, feel free to DM if you want to swap weeks on rotation. :rocket:
